items.text: Little optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; sidelined this week, expectation he will not go. Rams get Puka Nacua back.

items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for secondary Eagles WRs

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury sustained in Week 3.
items.why: Hamstring injury; coach Kellen Moore confirmed.
items.implication: Misses minimum 4 games; elevates Saints RB committee.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (back) and Zay Flowers (hamstring) upgraded to full participants on Ravens Thursday injury report.
items.implication: Both expected to play at full strength; positive for Ravens offense.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren TNF vs CLE as top-10 play: led all RBs 90% snap rate last week, 20/22 RB touches; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game; Dowdle out.
items.why: Workhorse usage on short week; favorable matchup.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% target share/104 ypg career with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return; NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Penix chemistry and volume; soft matchup.
items.opportunity: High target share, red-zone looks with Penix

items.text: HATE Justin Herbert @ SEA (44% pressure rate, SEA 4th pressure/low YPA; low implied total); Omarion Hampton @ SEA (low util 3.5% tgt/25% routes/42% snaps; SEA 2.9 YPC); Kyle Pitts @ NO (16% share/34 ypg career w/ Penix; TE37 util).
items.why: Tough matchups, poor recent usage/efficiency, limited opportunity.
items.opportunity: Constrained snaps/targets/routes for Hampton/Pitts; pressure for Herbert

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin) to play Sunday vs Eagles.
items.implication: WR1 returns; boosts Rams passing attack and fantasy ceiling.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed out for season; will undergo neck surgery after Week 2 injury; placed on IR. Not believed career-ending.
items.why: Neck injury requiring surgery; LaFleur confirmation.
items.implication: GB WR depth by committee; boosts Watson/Golden roles ROS.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Packers WRs

items.text: Week 4 waivers/injury beneficiaries: Etienne=IR → Kamara/Miller; Achane season-ending → Gordon/Wright; Hall → Allen; Reed implications; others like Goedert → Wicks. Drop considerations for low-usage/injured.
items.why: Detailed injury report + FAAB/drop/watch lists tied to absences.
items.implication: Prioritize adds for clear opportunity spikes from outs.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: Mitchell likely out again; 36% target share last without him; 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ ypr.
items.why: Clear WR1 volume without Mitchell; efficiency + matchup.

items.text: LOVE Josh Downs vs WSH (31% target share last 2, 43% RZ looks; WSH worst vs WRs/slot TDs) and George Kittle vs DEN (climbing target/route % to 27%; Evans DTD; DEN 8th-most TE yds).
items.why: Volume/RZ for Downs; rising role + matchup/Evans uncertainty for Kittle.
items.opportunity: High target/RZ shares; Kittle routes climbing

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Zach Charbonnet to return to practice.
items.why: Official designation; won't play this week but eligible soon.
items.implication: Could return within 3 weeks; monitor for Kenneth Walker handcuff value shift.
items.opportunity: Potential future committee or lead role

items.text: Fresh ROS rankings: Kenneth Walker #3 overall notable. Prefers Jonathan Taylor side in 2-for-1 trade (Flowers+Montgomery for JT) as getting the '1'.
items.implication: Strong ROS hold/buy for Walker; JT preferred asset.

items.text: Kyle Pitts underperformed opportunity most: only 6 targets/3 games, none inside 10, low aDOT. Texans run game historically futile (YPC ranks 27th-32nd recent years) regardless of personnel.
items.why: Target/aDOT data vs opportunity; multi-year YPC evidence.
items.implication: Fade Pitts; skepticism on Texans RBs/YPC.
items.opportunity: Low targets/red-zone for Pitts; poor run efficiency Houston
